Stephen Moore is currently a senior economist at FreedomWorks, a Distinguished Fellow at The Heritage Foundation, and a Fox News analyst.
Mora Namdar is an attorney and Senior Fellow at the American Foreign Policy Council. Mora served at the U.S. State Department and at the U.S. Agency for Global Media.
Peter Navarro served as Director of the Office of Trade and Manufacturing Policy and Defense Production Act Policy Coordinator.

text: William Perry Pendley was born in Cheyenne, Wyoming and later led the Bureau of Land Management.
Max Primorac was acting Chief Operating Officer at the U.S. Agency for International Development and worked at the U.S. Department of State.

Roger Severino served as director of the Office for Civil Rights at the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and later founded the HHS Accountability Project at the Ethics & Public Policy Center.

text: Kiron K. Skinner served as Director of Policy Planning at the U.S. Department of State and was on the Defense Business Board at the U.S. Department of Defense.
Brooks D. Tucker served in the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and advised Senator Richard Burr.
Hans A. von Spakovsky was a Commissioner on the Federal Election Commission and served at the U.S. Department of Justice.
Russ Vought served as Director of the Office of Management and Budget and led efforts in executive agencies.
William L. Walton served on boards including The Heritage Foundation, American Enterprise Institute, and U.S. Chamber of Commerce.
Paul Winfree led the team responsible for the Office of Management and Budget during the 2016 presidential transition.
Paul Dans is Director of the 2025 Presidential Transition Project at The Heritage Foundation and served at the U.S. Office of Personnel Management.
Steven Groves served as Chief of Staff at the U.S. Mission to the United Nations and later as White House Deputy Press Secretary.

The Constitution gives the executive Power to the President.
Beginning with George Washington, every President has been supported by a White House office and a Cabinet.
The Deputy Chief of Staff coordinates with the National Economic Council (NEC), the Domestic Policy Council (DPC), and the National Security Council (NSC).
The Office of Legislative Affairs (OLA) has continued to serve as the liaison between the White House and Congress.
The Office of White House Counsel works closely with the Department of Justice (DOJ) and the Attorney General.
